steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

def look_animal(label):
    r = p.look()
    print(f"== {label} ==\n{r[:350]}")
    a = p.filter_actions(include="animal", limit=10)
    if a: print("ANIMAL ACTIONS:", a)
    return a

# currently in bedroom; go to hallway
p.step_text_action("go to hallway")
for room in ["living room", "kitchen", "greenhouse"]:
    res = p.step_text_action(f"go to {room}")
    print(f"MOVE {room}:", res.get("observation_after","")[:80])
    look_animal(room)
    p.step_text_action("go to hallway")
print("SCORE:", p.check_success())
